evidence: Quint. 1.4.19: noster sermō articulōs nōn dēsīderat
terms.comment: Latin has no article, as Quintilian says. Varro uses articulus of the pronouns hic and quis; the later grammarians put hic, haec, hoc before nouns in their paradigms as articles, prōnōmina articulāria (Priscian, Servius; Lewis & Short s.v. articulāris), and Traupman follows them in his declensions (220, 245).

sources: Lewis & Short: articulus · Lewis & Short: articularis
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 220, p. 245.
